arxiv-2204-04687.title: MA-Dreamer: Coordination and communication through shared imagination
arxiv-2204-04687.creator: Kenzo Lobos-Tsunekawa, Akshay Srinivasan, Michael Spranger
arxiv-2204-04687.description: Abstract Multi-agent RL is rendered difficult due to the non-stationary nature of environment perceived by individual agents. Theoretically sound methods using the REINFORCE estimator are impeded by its high-variance, whereas value-function based methods are affected by issues stemming from their ad-hoc handling of situations like inter-agent communication.

arxiv-2205-03423.title: Primordial trispectrum from kSZ tomography
arxiv-2205-03423.creator: Neha Anil Kumar, Gabriela Sato-Polito, Marc Kamionkowski, Selim C. Hotinli
arxiv-2205-03423.description: Abstract The kinetic Sunyaev Zel’dovich effect is a secondary CMB temperature anisotropy that provides a powerful probe of the radial-velocity field of matter distributed across the Universe. This velocity field is reconstructed by combining high-resolution CMB measurements with galaxy survey data, and it provides an unbiased tracer of matter perturbations in the linear regime.

arxiv-2301-06375.title: OLKAVS: An Open Large-Scale Korean Audio-Visual Speech Dataset
arxiv-2301-06375.creator: Jeongkyun Park, Jung-Wook Hwang, Kwanghee Choi, Seung-Hyun Lee, Jun Hwan Ahn, Rae-Hong Park, Hyung-Min Park
arxiv-2301-06375.description: Abstract Inspired by humans comprehending speech in a multi-modal manner, various audio-visual datasets have been constructed. However, most existing datasets focus on English, induce dependencies with various prediction models during dataset preparation, and have only a small number of multi-view videos.

arxiv-2308-04835.title: Search for magnetic monopoles and stable particles with high electric charges in s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV p ​ p pp collisions with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-2308-04835.description: Abstract We present a search for magnetic monopoles and high-electric-charge objects using LHC Run 2 s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV proton–proton collisions recorded by the ATLAS detector. A total integrated luminosity of 138 138 fb -1 was collected by a specialized trigger. No highly ionizing particle candidate was observed.

arxiv-2311-13998.title: A multidimensional AI-trained correction to the 1D approximate model for Airborne TDEM sensing
arxiv-2311-13998.creator: Wouter Deleersnyder 1,2 , David Dudal 1,3 , Thomas Hermans 2 1 KU Leuven Campus Kortrijk - KULAK, Department of Physics, Etienne Sabbelaan 53, 8500 Kortrijk, Belgium. E-mail: wouter.deleersnyder@kuleuven.be 2 Ghent University, Department of Geology, Krijgslaan 281 - S8, 9000 Gent, Belgium 3 Ghent Un
arxiv-2311-13998.description: Abstract The computational resources required to solve the full 3D inversion of time-domain electromagnetic data are immense. To overcome the time-consuming 3D simulations, we construct a surrogate model, more precisely, a data-driven statistical model to replace the 3D simulations. It is trained on 3D data and predicts the approximate output much faster.

arxiv-2401-06251.title: Semantic-Preserving Feature Partitioning for Multi-View Ensemble Learning
arxiv-2401-06251.creator: Mohammad Sadegh Khorshidi, Navid Yazdanjue, Hassan Gharoun, Danial Yazdani, Mohammad Reza Nikoo, Fang Chen, Amir H. Gandomi
arxiv-2401-06251.description: Abstract In machine learning, the exponential growth of data and the associated “curse of dimensionality” pose significant challenges, particularly with expansive yet sparse datasets. Addressing these challenges, multi-view ensemble learning (MEL) has emerged as a transformative approach, with feature partitioning (FP) playing a pivotal role in constructing artificial views for MEL.

arxiv-2403-05946.title: Shear viscosity of quark-gluon plasma at finite temperature and chemical potential and QCD phase transitions
arxiv-2403-05946.creator: Wei-bo He, Guo-yun Shao, Chong-long Xie, Ren-xin Xu
arxiv-2403-05946.description: Abstract We explore the shear viscosity of quark-gluon plasma (QGP) in the full QCD phase diagram within the framework of kinetic theory with the relaxation time approximation based on the 2 ↔ 2 2\leftrightarrow 2 elastic scatterings of quark quasiparticles.

arxiv-2502-17314.title: Photoluminescence efficiency of MBE-grown MoSe 2 monolayers featuring sharp excitonic lines and diverse grain structures.
arxiv-2502-17314.creator: Mateusz Raczyński, Julia Kucharek, Kacper Oreszczuk, Aleksander Rodek, Tomasz Kazimierczuk, Rafał Bożek, Takashi Taniguchi, Kenji Watanabe, Wojciech Pacuski, Piotr Kossacki
arxiv-2502-17314.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mateusz Raczyński, Julia Kucharek, Kacper Oreszczuk, Aleksander Rodek, Tomasz Kazimierczuk, Rafał Bożek, Takashi Taniguchi, Kenji Watanabe, Wojciech Pacuski, Piotr Kossacki. Recent studies have demonstrated that using h-BN as a substrate for the growth of transition metal dichalcogenides can significantly reduce excitonic linewidths. However, many other optical parameters still require optimization. In this work, we present a detailed study of the low-temperature photoluminescence efficiency of MBE-grown MoSe 2 monolayers on h-BN substrates, comparing them to state-of-the-art exfoliated monolayers encapsulated in h-BN.

arxiv-2503-15995.title: The transition to phenomenological behaviour of static solutions of the Einstein-Dirac system for an increasing number of fermions
arxiv-2503-15995.creator: Håkan Andréasson
arxiv-2503-15995.description: Abstract Static spherically symmetric solutions to the Einstein-Dirac system were constructed numerically for the first time in 1999 by Finster, Smoller and Yau [ 18 ] in the case of two fermions. In 2020 this result was generalized by Leith, Hooley, Horne and Dritschel [ 25 ] to a system consisting of an even number κ \kappa of fermions.

arxiv-2510-02018.title: An electro-optical bunch profile monitor for FCC-ee
arxiv-2510-02018.creator: M. Reissig, E. Bründermann, S. Funkner, L.L. Grimm, B. Härer, G. Niehues, J. L. Steinmann, A.-S. Müller, R. Corsini, A. Gilardi, S. Mazzoni, C. Pakuza, A. Schloegelhofer, T. Lefevre, P. Korysko
arxiv-2510-02018.description: Abstract The Future Circular Lepton Collider (FCC-ee) presents challenges for a longitudinal bunch profile monitor due to its wide range of bunch lengths and charge densities across its four distinct operational modes. For commissioning, monitoring the top-up injection, and energy calibration, the FCC-ee requires non-destructive, single-shot measurements of the bunch length and profile.

arxiv-2511-09667.title: How AI Responses Shape User Beliefs: The Effects of Information Detail and Confidence on Belief Strength and Stance DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2018/06
arxiv-2511-09667.creator: Zekun Wu, Mayank Jobanputra, Vera Demberg, Jessica Hullman, Anna Maria Feit
arxiv-2511-09667.description: Abstract . The growing use of AI-generated responses in everyday tools raises concern about how subtle features such as supporting detail or tone of confidence may shape people’s beliefs. To understand this, we conducted a pre-registered online experiment (N=304) investigating how the detail and confidence of AI-generated responses influence belief change.

arxiv-2511-12542.creator: Caixing Gu, Meng Li, Pan Ma
arxiv-2511-12542.description: Abstract Motivated by the Sarason problem on the products of Hankel and Toeplitz operators on analytic function spaces, we characterize the compactness of products of block Hankel and Toeplitz operators on the vector-valued Hardy space of the unit disk via harmonic extension of the symbols and Douglas algebras generated by the symbols.

pmc-10562800.creator: Tasnim Sultana, Md Shaddam Hossain, Liton Chandra Voumik, Asif Raihan
pmc-10562800.description: Unquestionably, the industrial revolution of the twenty-first century contributes to global warming. Excessive amounts of carbon emissions into the atmosphere are responsible for global warming. pmc-11272786.title: Direct and indirect costs of parasitism preceding a population decline of an Arctic ungulate
pmc-11272786.creator: Eleanor R. Dickinson, Chinyere Nwafor-Okoli, Sylvia L. Checkley, Brett Elkin, Marsha Branigan, Emmanuel Serrano, Susan J. Kutz
pmc-11272786.description: Parasites negatively affect the fitness of ungulate hosts directly, and in wild ungulates, these effects may be synzootic with other stressors, such as limited nutritional resources. In the Arctic, muskoxen (Ovibos moschatus) occur in a highly seasonal environment and must rely on finite energetic resources for survival and productivity.

pmc-12566033.title: Towards Advanced Materials: Functional Perspectives of Co-Doped ZnO Thin Films
pmc-12566033.creator: Mariuca Gartner, Mariana Chelu, Anna Szekeres, Peter Petrik
pmc-12566033.description: Zinc oxide (ZnO) thin films have attracted increasing attention as promising materials for sensing applications due to their wide band gap, high exciton binding energy, and remarkable chemical stability. However, the inherent limitations of pure ZnO, such as moderate sensitivity, selectivity, and relatively high operating temperatures, limit its widespread use in advanced sensing technologies.

pmc-13115496.title: Comparative Evaluation of a Nanocellulose Hydrogel and Matrigel® in a Vascularized Intestinal–CAM Model
pmc-13115496.creator: Christa Schimpel, Christina Passegger, Kerstin Auer, Herbert Strobl, Waltraud Huber, Nassim Ghaffari-Tabrizi-Wizsy
pmc-13115496.description: Hydrogel-based scaffolds are central to three-dimensional (3D) epithelial culture systems, yet commonly used matrices such as Matrigel® suffer from batch variability, undefined composition, and limited translational relevance. Here, we comparatively evaluated an animal-free nanocellulose hydrogel (GrowDex®) and Matrigel® in a hybrid vascularized intestinal–chorioallantoic membrane (CAM) model.

pmc-13563897.title: Impact of denosumab therapy on periapical healing following root canal treatment: a 10-year retrospective case-control study
pmc-13563897.creator: Bokyung Shin, Ji-Young Yoon, Yeon-Jee Yoo, Won-Jun Shon
pmc-13563897.description: IntroductionDenosumab is a potent RANKL inhibitor used for osteoporosis, yet its impact on root canal treatment (RCT) outcomes remains less understood compared to bisphosphonates. This study evaluated the periapical healing outcomes of RCT in patients receiving denosumab and identified clinical variables influencing treatment success.

pmc-13677220.description: Rationale & Objective3-epi-25(OH)D3, an epimeric form of 25(OH)D3 generated by C-3 epimerization, declines with advancing chronic kidney disease (CKD), yet its role in vascular health and related outcomes remains largely unknown.
